title: [CRAFT] | Auto Farm, Auto Walls, Auto Spins.
features:
Farm
- Farms the world that gives the most gold a minute
- Breaks walls once it can finish them, holds rank ups so your damage stays high
- Ranks up, buys upgrades and new areas
- Dashes between enemies, optional teleport to enemies
- Stands where several enemies fit in your attack circle
Spins and items
- Auto spins for every gacha, you pick which ones and they take turns
- Uses potions when they count: damage at walls, luck on spins
- Crafts jewels tier by tier
- Equips your best gear, swaps sets for raids
Modes
- Raids with ticket saving, portals, invasion, time trial
- Harbor expeditions and global bosses
Everything else
- Claims daily, time, pass, chests and quests
- Redeems every code in one click
- Weather tracker
- Closes the Roblox favorite popup
- Anti AFK, auto rejoin, configs, themes
- Menu works on PC and phone
Everything is on from the start. Untick what you don't need.
